name: Request & Domain Validation
description: Request & Domain Validation standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-VALID applies.

rules.title: Separate transport validation from business validation
rules.detail: Request shape/type/range validation occurs at the boundary; domain rules that require business state remain in application/domain logic.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Separate transport validation from business validation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Separate transport validation from business validation.

rules.title: Reject invalid input before side effects
rules.detail: Do not write data or call external side effects before mandatory validation for the operation has passed.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Reject invalid input before side effects.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Reject invalid input before side effects.

rules.title: Return stable validation codes and field paths
rules.detail: Clients receive machine-readable codes/field identifiers and safe messages suitable for UI mapping.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Return stable validation codes and field paths.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Return stable validation codes and field paths.

rules.title: Do not trust client-calculated authoritative values
rules.detail: Recompute prices, permissions, ownership, status transitions and other protected values on the server.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not trust client-calculated authoritative values.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not trust client-calculated authoritative values.

rules.title: Validate collections and payload size
rules.detail: Enforce maximum item counts, string/file sizes and nesting depth to protect performance and security.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Validate collections and payload size.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Validate collections and payload size.

rules.title: Keep validation rules consistent across entry points
rules.detail: HTTP, queue, job or administrative paths that perform the same use case must enforce the same business invariants.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep validation rules consistent across entry points.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep validation rules consistent across entry points.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-VALID applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Request & Domain Validation to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Request & Domain Validation is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Request & Domain Validation failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
